### Fewer steps, more control across workflows


Join Caroline Wells, Senior Technical Specialist at Seequent, for a tour of the Oasis montaj 2026.1 release. This video highlights the latest improvements across database handling, map navigation, and radiometric processing, with practical updates designed to reduce the number of steps in common workflows and give you greater control over everyday tasks.
